study_identification_part.si_4_title: Individualized gray matter morphological abnormalities uncover two robust transdiagnostic biotypes

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: CNP (UCLA Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics) discovery dataset; COBRE validation dataset 1; DIRECT (site 20) validation dataset 2; Unknown = SALD (Southwest University adult lifespan dataset) used to construct a normal structural covariance network.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "A total of 496 patients with psychiatric disorders and 255 heathy controls from three independent datasets (one discovery dataset and two validation datasets) were included in this study. Additionally, another extensive dataset comprising 492 healthy individuals aged 19 -80 was included to construct a normal structural covariance network... The discovery dataset was obtained from the University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA) Consortium for Neuropsychiatric Phenomics (CNP)... The validation dataset 1 was obtained from the Centre for Biomedical Research Excellence (COBRE)... The validation dataset 2 was obtained from site 20 of the Depression Imaging Research Consortium (DIRECT)"

answer.CNP: discovery dataset for deriving deviation maps and transdiagnostic subtypes

answer.COBRE: validation dataset 1 to test reproducibility/generalizability in schizophrenia

answer.DIRECT: validation dataset 2 to test generalizability in depression

answer.Unknown: SALD dataset used to construct a normal structural covariance network

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Discovery dataset used for subtype discovery based on normative modeling; two validation datasets used for reproducibility/generalizability analyses; SALD used for normal structural covariance network construction.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "First, we derived individualized deviation maps... and used them to determine transdiagnostic subtypes in the discovery dataset. We then conducted a series of sensitivity analyses to examine the reproducibility and generalizability of the identified subtypes... in the validation datasets... Additionally, another extensive dataset comprising 492 healthy individuals aged 19 -80 was included to construct a normal structural covariance network"
